title: astracantha parnassi subsp. cyllenea
intro: Astracantha parnassi subsp. cyllenea, commonly known as Astragalus cylleneus, is a plant species belonging to the legume family and is native to Greece. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus cylleneus are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
